native100.selection: Fixed nominal times; exclude 18–21 seconds and old 20-frame neighborhoods; no outcome-based replacement.

body10.subject: S9
body10.selection: Ten preselected test-sequence midpoints in the available official RGB archive; no replacements.
body10.calibration: Official left/right Scaramuzza calibration; uniform 872→720 resize and horizontal padding to1280×720, calibration transformed consistently.
body10.gt: Official sparse GT15; Head excluded, ToeBase uses paper heel proxy.

hand10.crops: Official 2D-keypoint-derived hand boxes; rescale_factor=2.0, following paper benchmark conditions.

scoring: Independent proper similarity PA (scale, rotation, translation, no reflection) per image; average left/right errors, then ten pairs. PA-MPVPE is aligned separately on778 vertices. Units mm.
paper_reference: EgoWholeView, arXiv:2610.16256v1; exact same-sample historical cache, not a fresh paper-model run. Published full-test means are separately labeled.
diagnosis: Only reconstruct and score existing saved parameters; no network inference, no optimization, no parameter change.

rollback.mode: Independent worktree; preserve old and new results.
